items.stem: A facility manager must decide between run-to-failure and preventive maintenance for a critical air-handling unit. Which factor most justifies preventive maintenance?

options.text: The unit's failure would cause high consequence and costly unplanned downtime
options.rationale: Correct: high failure consequence and downtime cost justify planned preventive maintenance.

options.text: The unit is inexpensive and easy to replace
options.rationale: Low consequence and easy replacement can justify run-to-failure, not preventive maintenance.

options.text: Spare parts are always in stock
options.rationale: Parts availability alone does not determine the maintenance strategy.

options.text: The unit is located near the manager's office
options.rationale: Physical location is irrelevant to the maintenance strategy decision.

items.explanation: Correct: high failure consequence and downtime cost justify planned preventive maintenance.

items.stem: When evaluating a facility sustainability initiative, which measure best reflects operational energy performance for benchmarking?

options.text: Energy use intensity (energy per unit floor area over time)
options.rationale: Correct: energy use intensity normalizes consumption by area and time for benchmarking.

options.text: The total purchase price of the building
options.rationale: Purchase price is a capital figure, not an operational energy measure.

options.text: The number of occupants on the busiest day
options.rationale: Peak occupancy alone does not measure energy performance.

options.text: The age of the HVAC manufacturer's brand
options.rationale: Brand age is unrelated to measured energy performance.

items.explanation: Correct: energy use intensity normalizes consumption by area and time for benchmarking.

items.stem: Select TWO elements that belong in a facility emergency preparedness plan.

options.text: Defined evacuation routes and assembly points
options.rationale: Correct: evacuation routes and assembly points are core emergency-plan elements.

options.text: Assigned roles and a communication protocol for incidents
options.rationale: Correct: role assignment and communication protocols are essential to response.

options.text: A guarantee that no emergency will ever occur
options.rationale: No plan can guarantee the absence of emergencies.

options.text: A rule to delay all notifications until after the event is over
A policy to remove all exit signage to reduce clutter
options.rationale: Removing exit signage would degrade, not improve, safety.

items.explanation: Correct: evacuation routes and assembly points are core emergency-plan elements.
